if (
    f.has_default()

        form.data, form.files, form.add_prefix(f.name)

    and cleaned_data.get(f.name) in form[f.name].field.empty_values
):
    continue
```

This skips setting the value when the field has a default AND the value is omitted from the data AND the cleaned data is empty. The fix should check if the field value in the form data is actually empty, not just if it was omitted from the data.
